papers.title: GS-Scale: Unlocking Large-Scale 3D Gaussian Splatting Training via Host Offloading
papers.version: Author final PDF; distinct from arXiv2509.15645v1 dated2025-09-19
papers.innovation: Geometry stays GPU-resident; appearance offloads. Early parameter forwarding overlaps CPU Adam with GPU work; deferred zero-gradient updates reduce host traffic; balanced image splitting bounds activations.
papers.testbeds: Table 1/p8, section 5.1/p9: i7-13620H/4070 Mobile 8GB/32GB host; i9-13900K/4080 Super 16GB/64GB host; dual Xeon 6530/H100 PCIe 80GB/1TB host. PyTorch 2.2/CUDA 12.4/gsplat 1.5.
papers.workload: Table 2/p9: Mill19 Rubble/Building 1152x864; GauU LFLS/SZIIT/SZTU 1600x1064; MatrixCity Aerial 1600x900. Batch 1; densification adjusted; mem_limit 0.3.

experiment_groups.reported: Peak-memory geomean 3.98x reduction. Versus GPU-only throughput 1.22x/0.84x, excluding OOM; versus naive 4.47x/4.57x.
Quality evaluated; epsilon term is approximated, not bitwise-equivalent Adam.

experiment_groups.variable: H100 testbed; GCP Aerial singleL4 vs2/4L4 Grendel
experiment_groups.reported: SingleL4 7.05h;2L4 4.46h;4L4 2.46h. Cost advantage is not faster wall-clock.
Explicit memory-capacity/throughput tradeoff and NUMA sensitivity.
Different quality/memory operating points; not a pure hardware-control study.

papers.strong_software_collision: Already absorbs host culling bottleneck via GPU geometry, CPU-optimizer overlap and zero-gradient memory suppression. OpenMP extension exists (section 5.1); exact OMP thread/affinity setting is not specified in reviewed methods.
papers.not_established: No our speedup; no residual CPU stall after fully qualified local replication. No permission to label optimization mathematically identical: deferred update drops epsilon.
papers.resource_measurement_scope: Section 5.1 footnote/p9: GPU peak is PyTorch allocated memory; reserved pools excluded, so OOM can precede allocated-capacity limit. Not directly interchangeable with our NVML cap.

papers.title: CLM: Removing the GPU Memory Barrier for 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.version: 17-page author final PDF; project repository title adds CPU Offloading, paper title does not
papers.innovation: Keep selection-critical10/59 attributes GPU-resident; selective pinned-memory loading; exact adjacent-microbatch Gaussian reuse; early-finalized CPU Adam; TSP scheduling and prioritized communication stream.
papers.testbeds: Section 6.1/p7: 5955WX 16 cores/128GB/4090 24GB/PCIe 4; E5-2660v3 listed 20 cores/256GB/2080 Ti 11GB/PCIe 3. Grendel single-GPU with gsplat CUDA.
papers.workload: Table3/p8:Bicycle200images4K BS4;Rubble1600/4K BS8;Alameda1700/2K BS8;Ithaca8200/1K BS16;BigCity60000/1080p BS64.

experiment_groups.variable: Maximum trainable scale and model-state memory
experiment_groups.reported: Up to 6.1x enhanced-baseline capacity; BigCity 102.2M Gaussians; 500k-step quality scaling.
Throughput 86-97% of enhanced GPU baseline on 2080 Ti, 55-90% on 4090; 1.38-1.92x naive offloading. Pipeline intervals include overlapping compute+communication.
TSP minimizes communication;GaussianCount usually minimizes Adam tail. Faster transfer can increase visible optimizer tail; tail alone is not end-to-end benefit.
Pinned memory up to37.8GB on4090,17.5GB on2080Ti. SMsActive sampled10kHz over>100batches.
CPU core occupancy from SCHED_EVENTS; bandwidth metrics10kHz. This is not a complete OMP/affinity-control experiment.

papers.strong_software_collision: Already includes camera/visibility reuse, reduced SH/appearance transfer, optimizer overlap, working-set selective loading and scheduling. Q1 cannot claim these broad mechanisms new.
papers.not_established: Paper says batch-internal reordering preserves mathematical gradient update; FP sum order still needs a local numerical contract. CPU thread count/affinity and local physical-vs-logical core mapping remain replication questions.
papers.resource_measurement_scope: AppendixCPU occupancy averages core scheduling time, not a frozen OMP-thread scaling experiment. Pinned-memory demand17.5/37.8GB is separate from totalhostRSS.

papers.title: TideGS: Scalable Training of Over One Billion 3D Gaussian Splatting Primitives via Out-of-Core Optimization
papers.innovation: Morton4096-Gaussian blocks;SSD/CPU/GPU caches;asynchronous read,H2D,compute,D2H andlazy log-writeback;trajectory-driven differential resident-set streaming.
papers.testbeds: Section 4.1/p6: A5000 24GB, EPYC 7532 32 cores, 256GB DDR4, PM9A3 SSD measured 3.3GB/s, PyTorch 2.6/CUDA 12.4. Appendix adds 3090/A800.
papers.workload: MipNeRF360 BS4/30kiterations;MatrixCity BigCity/AerialRGB-D51623trainingimages,fixed25M/102M/1.1B initializations,no densification/pruning for scale test. Default throughputBS64/16GB CPUcache;conservativeBS16/32GB.

experiment_groups.reported: Native~11.5M measured;naive~50M partly extrapolated from25M/12.13GB,not all measured maximum;CLM~105M;Tide>1B.
253.5/305.3/304.3/309.1/285.8ms. Native remains faster;utilization is nvidia-smi1Hz,not CLM10kHz SMsActive.
Full90.7ms;noDifferential145.3;noOverlap210.5;noMorton115.8. Author ablation, not our causal result.
Order changes latency andquality;not purely same optimization trajectory.
Additional measured hardware;resident Adam cold-restart0.6/0.9%updates at102M/1.1B. Cost operating point not universal superiority.

papers.strong_software_collision: Trajectory reuse, incremental cross-tier transfers, overlap and budgeted working sets directly preempt broad Q1 cache/prefetch/hide-wait novelty.
papers.semantic_and_version_limits: Section 3.5/p6 discards optimizer moments on eviction and cold-restarts admission; trajectory replaces random order. Current repo README says release Torch 2.4+cu124, paper 2.6. Repo BS16/32GB default differs from default paper throughput BS64/16GB; do not silently mix.
papers.not_established: No preserved-original-Adam numerical equivalence. Paperfrontier says CLMrasterizationOOM~105M while1.1Bcaption highlightsgeometry~45GB; record scale-specific causes rather than one universal cause.
papers.resource_measurement_scope: Reported GPUutilization=nvidia-smi1Hz, not a direct critical-path wait trace orSMsActive equivalence; paper machine256GBRAM, throughputcache16GB plus otherhoststate. No claim entire training fits our prior16GiBhost cap.

papers.title: GSArch: Breaking Memory Barriers in 3D Gaussian Splatting Training via Architectural Support
papers.innovation: Publisher abstract:hot/cold Gaussian onchip buffering;low-contribution gradient filtering;bank-conflict rearrangement.

experiment_groups.reported: Author maxima 6.49x/15.42x; not our measurements. Fulltext was not accessible through primary URLs, so simulator/RTL/silicon methodology, scenes, figures/tables and PPA not verified.

papers.strong_software_collision: Training backward reuse/atomic-gradient/bank-conflict hardware design is prior art. This differs from host optimizer/CPU-GPU exposed wait;cannot transfer its speedup denominator to Q1.
papers.not_established: Do not call speedups silicon measurements or establish simulation details from third-party reproductions. Secondary Scribd/search snippets were excluded as evidence.

our_synthesis_not_author_result.required_residual: First measure exposed critical-path CPU/GPU wait after strong software is configured, not aggregate task durations or low utilization. Keep OMP/thread count, affinity, NUMA placement, native BLAS/Torch threads, I/O workers, pinning and CPU clock policy recorded and controlled; use symmetric end-to-end samples.
our_synthesis_not_author_result.confound: Changing OMP can change CPU optimizer latency and GPUfeed timing without changing GPUhardware. Low averageutilization alone does not establish PCIe saturation or a GPUarchitectural defect. GPUcompute/transfer/CPU tails overlap; do notsum them.
our_synthesis_not_author_result.minimum_next_discriminator: Same scene,cameras,iteration window,model/optimizer semantics andresource budget;strongCLM/Tide-likebaseline vsoneprocess-local threading/affinity change with critical-path wait andtraffic observed. If software eliminates exposed wait,SOFTWARE_ABSORBED;only surviving cost may motivate explicit hardware variable.
our_synthesis_not_author_result.quality_contract: GSScaleepsilonapproximation,Tideoptimizerrestart/order/maskedcapacity andCLMbatchFPorder require independent acceptance. Author quality similarity does not authorize altering our contract.
